sources.title: Qwen Image LoRA Explorer - a Hugging Face Space by multimodalart
sources.snippet: This application allows users to generate images by selecting a LoRA model and entering a prompt. Users can choose from predefined LoRA styles or add their own custom LoRA models.

sources.title: FINE-TUNING MULTI-MODAL LLMS WITH ART: - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Our fine-tuning adapts the model by optimizing a single task-specific ART input image routed through the standard vision pathway. The model remains completely frozen, and fine-tuned prompts are treated by the serving infrastructure as plain multi-modal requests.

sources.snippet: There are two main Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) techniques for Large Language Models (LLMs). While Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) introduces additional weights between the LLM layers, Soft Prompting introduces additional fine-tuning-specific raw tokens to an LLM input.
